name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_congr
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) {A B : Ω → Prop},
  (∀ (ω : Ω), A ω ↔ B ω) → RiffleLowerV2.probability P A = RiffleLowerV2.probability P B

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_mono
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) {A B : Ω → Prop},
  (∀ (ω : Ω), A ω → B ω) → RiffleLowerV2.probability P A ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P B

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_nonneg
type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Prop), 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P A

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_le_one
type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Prop), RiffleLowerV2.probability P A ≤ 1

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_true
type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω), (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (x : Ω) => True) = 1

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_false
type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω), (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (x : Ω) => False) = 0

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_not
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => ¬A ω) = 1 - RiffleLowerV2.probability P A

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_and_le_left
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A B : Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A ω ∧ B ω) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P A

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.probability_and_le_right
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A B : Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A ω ∧ B ω) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P B

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_indicator_mul
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A B : Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => (if A ω then 1 else 0) * if B ω then 1 else 0) =
    RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A ω ∧ B ω

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_eq
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ),
  RiffleLowerV2.variance P f = (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => f ω ^ 2) - RiffleLowerV2.expect P f ^ 2

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_nonneg
type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ), 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.variance P f

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (t : ℝ),
  0 < t →
    (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => t ≤ |f ω - RiffleLowerV2.expect P f|) ≤
      RiffleLowerV2.variance P f / t ^ 2

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_variance_le
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (η t : ℝ),
  0 < RiffleLowerV2.expect P f →
    0 < t →
      RiffleLowerV2.variance P f ≤ RiffleLowerV2.expect P f + η * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f ^ 2 →
        (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => t * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f ≤ |f ω - RiffleLowerV2.expect P f|) ≤
          1 / (t ^ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f) + η / t ^ 2

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.lower_tail_success
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (η t : ℝ),
  0 < RiffleLowerV2.expect P f →
    0 < t →
      RiffleLowerV2.variance P f ≤ RiffleLowerV2.expect P f + η * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f ^ 2 →
        1 - 1 / (t ^ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f) - η / t ^ 2 ≤
          RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => (1 - t) * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f < f ω

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.positive_success
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (η : ℝ),
  0 < RiffleLowerV2.expect P f →
    RiffleLowerV2.variance P f ≤ RiffleLowerV2.expect P f + η * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f ^ 2 →
      1 - 1 / RiffleLowerV2.expect P f - η ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => 0 < f ω

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount
type: {Ω : Type u_1} → {ι : Type u_2} → Finset ι → (ι → Ω → Prop) → Ω → ℝ

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount_nonneg
type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} (W : Finset ι) (A : ι → Ω → Prop) (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount W A ω

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_eventCount
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (W : Finset ι) (A : ι → Ω → Prop),
  RiffleLowerV2.expect P (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount W A) = ∑ i ∈ W, RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i)

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_eventCount_sq
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (W : Finset ι) (A : ι → Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount W A ω ^ 2) =
    ∑ i ∈ W, ∑ j ∈ W, RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A i ω ∧ A j ω

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_eventCount
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (W : Finset ι) (A : ι → Ω → Prop),
  RiffleLowerV2.variance P (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount W A) =
    ∑ i ∈ W,
      ∑ j ∈ W,
        ((RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A i ω ∧ A j ω) -
          RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i) * RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A j))

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_eventCount_le
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (W : Finset ι) (A : ι → Ω → Prop) (η : ℝ),
  0 ≤ η →
    (∀ i ∈ W,
        ∀ j ∈ W,
          i ≠ j →
            |(RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A i ω ∧ A j ω) -
                  RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i) * RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A j)| ≤
              η * RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i) * RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A j)) →
      RiffleLowerV2.variance P (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount W A) ≤
        RiffleLowerV2.expect P (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount W A) +
          η * RiffleLowerV2.expect P (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount W A) ^ 2

name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_collisionCount_le
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (W : Finset (RiffleLowerV2.Word k K)) (η : ℝ),
  0 ≤ η →
    (∀ w ∈ W,
        ∀ v ∈ W,
          w ≠ v →
            |(RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                    RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w ω ∧ RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent v ω) -
                  RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w) *
                    RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent v)| ≤
              η * RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w) *
                RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent v)) →
      RiffleLowerV2.variance (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount W) ≤
        RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount W) +
          η * RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount W) ^ 2
